summary: With no subplan you follow General Biology: four BioFoundations courses, the two foundational labs, math, physics, chemistry and statistics, and 23 units of electives. Each subplan instead has its own foundations, STEM courses and electives, drawing on its Menu I list plus the Biology and approved out-of-department lists, with at most one extra BIO 80-series course, one extra lab and 7 units of BIO 199/199X. The audit counts your courses toward 89 units. The capstone is honors (10 research units, BIO 199W, a thesis and a 3.0 GPA), the Independent Capstone, the Notation in Science Communication, or interdisciplinary honors (checked by hand). Left: only one STEM course and one elective may be taken Credit/No Credit, which the audit does not limit, and BIO 102's stated 4 units exceed its 3-unit listing, so only the course is required.
